resources.string: Allows an administrator to apply FocusGate app restrictions on a fully managed or dedicated device.
Shows whether FocusGate monitoring is active and permissions are intact.
Warns when protection stops or the block screen cannot be shown.
Usage Access is missing - protection is not active
Display over other apps is missing - the block screen cannot appear
Emergency access is active - restrictions are paused
Android refused the overlay for %1$s. Open FocusGate to check permissions.
FocusGate monitoring is not running. Open FocusGate and tap Restart protection.
%1$s is restricted. Finish your Must Do tasks to earn unlock time.
This pauses all app restrictions for 10 minutes. Use it only for an urgent need; the status screen will show that protection is paused.

Personal Strict Mode: this is a friction layer, not a tamper-proof lock. Usage and overlay permissions can be revoked at any time in system settings. Emergency access pauses restrictions for 10 minutes.
